targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS pool, name AS host, labels->>'address' AS address, labels->>'version' AS version, labels->>'master' AS master, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND object_key LIKE 'host:%'
 ORDER BY device_name, name

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (avg(value)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_raw m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'cpu_percent' AND m.object LIKE 'host:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms < 300000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value
  FROM metrics_5m m
 WHERE m.tenant_id = '$tenant' AND m.check_id IN ($check) AND m.name = 'cpu_percent' AND m.object LIKE 'host:%' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) AND $__interval_ms >= 300000 AND $__interval_ms < 3600000
 GROUP BY 1, 2
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(m.time, $__interval), (SELECT coalesce(s.object_name, nullif(s.object, ''), s.check_name) FROM metric_series_v s WHERE s.series_id = m.series_id) AS metric, (sum(sum) / sum(count)) * 1 AS value

panels.title: VMs not running or not OK

targets.rawSql:
SELECT device_name AS pool, name AS vm, labels->>'power_state' AS power, labels->>'guest_tools' AS tools, status, last_output
  FROM check_objects_v
 WHERE tenant_id = '$tenant' AND check_id IN ($check) AND gone_at IS NULL AND object_key LIKE 'vm:%' AND (status <> 'OK' OR labels->>'power_state' <> 'Running')
 ORDER BY status = 'OK', device_name, name
